what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted 6-1 to recommend Article 6, the capital plan, after long debate over whether Town Meeting can change individual items.
Town counsel's opinion, as discussed, is that only the capital appropriation total can be amended; the chair will ask the moderators whether a single-item amendment is possible.
The committee recommended Article 4, a FY22 budget amendment transferring among seven lines, and Article 7, the administrative organization plan, both unanimously.
It recommended Articles 22 and 23 and found no financial impact for Article 24, all 7-0, then recommended the consent calendar unanimously.
The sewer bylaw, Article 25, stays deferred until the Town Meeting caucus.

why_it_matters: Residents at Town Meeting will vote on a capital plan that, on town counsel's reading, can be changed only by raising or lowering the total, not by striking or editing single items such as the vehicle and mower purchases.
The primary school air conditioning cost is still awaited, so a gap could later be covered by another appropriation or by school funds, which could mean another vote.
watch_next: The chair's answer from the moderator and assistant moderator on a single-item capital amendment, and any pre-meeting caucus.
Committee meetings on May 12 (Town Meeting recap and off-season agenda) and May 26.
